description: This file is a PHP script for rendering and managing the edit view of a module in the vtiger CRM system, including form setup, validation, and sequence number handling.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: Class for CRM entity operations, used here to get an instance of the current module.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template class customized for vtiger CRM.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns an instance of CRMEntity for the current module.

methods.name: getParentTab
methods.description: Retrieves the parent tab/category for the current module.

methods.name: setObjectValuesFromRequest
methods.description: Sets object properties from request parameters.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Determines the view mode based on focus mode.

methods.name: getBlocks
methods.description: Retrieves form blocks for the module view.

methods.name: getEntityName
methods.description: Retrieves entity name(s) for a given record.

methods.name: updateInfo
methods.description: Retrieves update information for a record.

methods.name: getTabid
methods.description: Gets the tab ID for the current module.

methods.name: parse_calendardate
methods.description: Parses date format for calendar display.

methods.name: getModuleSequenceField
methods.description: Retrieves sequence number field info for the module.
